title: OpalineWilds
description: Server modpack for Opaline Wilds. This holds everything you need to play Opaline
body: This mod pack aims to provide a beautiful experience for when we crave a two-week Minecraft adventure. While also having a somewhat vanilla feel, this pack has many different ways to provide a good amount of realism. From a multitude of biomes, to the multitude of dungeons, to growing fresh crops that can turn into tasty dishes, this quality-of-life modpack will make your next two weeks worth it. For my boogie men.
